commonMistakes.tr: Bu islemde en sik hata yanlis klasore NTFS izni vermek yerine sadece paylasim izni vermektir. Gerekirse Security sekmesini de kontrol et.
commonMistakes.en: The most common mistake is granting only share permission instead of NTFS on the correct folder. Check the Security tab when needed.

verificationChecks.tr: Security sekmesi, Effective Access, Share Permissions, grup uyeligi, inheritance ve Deny kayitlarini kontrol et.
verificationChecks.en: Check Security tab, Effective Access, Share Permissions, group membership, inheritance, and Deny entries.

expertTips.tr: NTFS ve paylasim izni birlikte calisir; kullanici her iki katmanda da yetkili olmalidir.
expertTips.en: NTFS and share permissions work together; the user must be authorized at both layers.

riskWarnings.tr: Deny izni Allow'dan daha gucludur; Effective Access ile dogrula.
riskWarnings.en: Deny overrides Allow; verify with Effective Access.

commonMistakes.tr: Secili dosya veya yanlis klasore izin vermek cok yaygindir. Hedef klasore gitmeden Properties acma.
commonMistakes.en: Granting permission on the selected file or wrong folder is common. Navigate to the target folder before opening Properties.

verificationChecks.tr: Address bar, secili oge ve hedef path ayni klasoru gosteriyor mu kontrol et.
verificationChecks.en: Verify address bar, selected item, and target path all refer to the same folder.
